name: Comfort Commotrade Limited
about: Comfort Commotrade Limited engages in the commodity broking business in India. The company trades various commodities, such as bullion, including gold and silver; energy, including crude oil and natural gas; metals; food grains, such as rice and maize; spices; oil and oil seeds; and others. It also trades in shares and securities. Comfort Commotrade Limited was founded in 1994 and is based in Mumbai, India.
